name: pdfluent
description: PDFluent plugins for Claude Code: read, search and fill local PDFs, or call the hosted Extract and PDF APIs.

plugins.name: pdfluent
plugins.description: Read, search and fill local PDFs as markdown, text, tables and form fields. Runs on your machine; your documents are never uploaded.

plugins.name: pdfluent-extract
plugins.description: PDFluent Extract API as MCP tools: PDF to markdown, text, tables and chunks, plus search and document info. Asks for your PDFluent API key; calls are paid in credits.

plugins.name: pdfluent-pdf
plugins.description: PDFluent PDF API as MCP tools: merge, split, compress, redact, fill forms, convert, PDF/A and OCR. Asks for your PDFluent API key; calls are paid in credits.

plugins.name: pdfluent-hosted
plugins.description: Both products in one plugin: the full PDFluent hosted tool set at /mcp. Kept so existing installs keep working; new installs should pick pdfluent-extract or pdfluent-pdf.
